title: Platform: Activity, one event
summary: The Platform → Activity page with one event open in the detail drawer: Session length changed from 30 days to 14 days, with before and after, who, when to the second, where it lives, when it applies and one way to the setting.
compare: The drawer opens from the row (the row stays selected under the scrim): title says what changed, then Before, After (the new value in strong), Who, When with the zone, Where.
One consequence row, Applies: at each person's next sign-in; one action, Open the setting, outlined; no destructive action from Activity.
Drawer head: a 3px Platform violet rule and the head band, no glyph (B4); phone: a bottom sheet with the action pinned.
Before/after renders values the way their setting does (durations, roles, ids in mono).
Round 2 (UX review): The selected row under the drawer is the tint and a 3px bar in its event's service accent (B17).
